task.description: Implement OBS-06 alerting hooks in backend Zig code according to src/design/obs-06-alerting-hooks.md. Add configurable webhook alert delivery for: (1) instance in ERROR for > N minutes, (2) DLQ depth threshold crossing with one-shot/re-arm semantics, and (3) scheduler lag threshold breach. Implement deterministic payload contracts and correlation IDs, bounded delivery retries (3 attempts) with exponential backoff, and terminal failure structured logging aligned with OBS-01. Ensure integration with OBS-05 DLQ depth source and SCH-02 scheduler lag source. Enforce idempotent trigger behavior so depth-above-threshold does not fire every poll and re-fires only after crossing again post-recovery. Include tests and any required migration/config plumbing consistent with backend conventions.
acceptance_criteria: zig build with grep -i error set returns no output
OBS-06 acceptance criteria and edge cases are covered by implementation and tests

result.summary: Implemented OBS-06 alerting hooks with deterministic payload/correlation contracts, one-shot/re-arm threshold semantics, bounded 3-attempt exponential retry dispatch, structured terminal failure logging, and OBS-06 state migration/config plumbing.
